decisions.reason: Two-page flipbook display balance does not change the separately stated standard for eliminating empty space at article endings.
The display requirement does not select a new hosting platform or alter the existing free-hosting and candidate-platform state.
Balanced two-page flipbook display does not change the requirement that advertisements render without blurriness.
The flipbook spread-display decision does not change the independently stated article body-font requirement.
The table of contents must already use page numbers from the finalized layout; no page number or completion condition is changed by the spread-display requirement.
The source decision adds a flipbook display constraint but does not alter the existing launch deadline.
Two-page spread behavior does not modify the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The source requires the final PDF to display properly as two-page spreads but does not explicitly change article order, placement, or any current pagination value.
The flipbook spread-display decision does not change author names, photos, sizing, shape, coverage, or source.
The two-page spread requirement does not alter the magazine's branding, visual style, or color-use rules.
Flipbook spread balance does not change how uninterrupted article text is broken up with images, blurbs, or quotes.
The display behavior does not add, remove, or otherwise change any required issue content.
